svg.text: Forward of one MLP block at TP = 2: SP off vs SP on
s = 256 tokens, b = 2 sequences, h = 512, ffn = 2048. Matmuls are written on the flattened (s·b) × h = 512 × 512 activation. Both rank lanes are shown; a tall bar is a collective between them.
TP region: hidden dim split, exactly Day 11 (identical with SP on or off)
SP off: 1 ALL-REDUCE per block in forward. Outside the TP region both ranks hold the same full [256, 2, 512] activation: a duplicate copy.
SP on: 1 ALL-GATHER + 1 REDUCE-SCATTER per block (together the same bytes as one all-reduce). Outside the TP region each rank holds only its half: [128, 2, 512].
ENTER the TP region (column-parallel input needs every token): SP off → nothing (identity f) · SP on → ALL-GATHER
LEAVE the TP region (row-parallel output is a partial sum): SP off → ALL-REDUCE (all tokens to all) · SP on → REDUCE-SCATTER (my tokens to me)
Attention is the same pattern: column = linear_qkv, Aqkv,r is 512×768 (4 of 8 heads); core attention per rank → [256, 2, 256]; row = linear_proj, Aproj,r is 256×512.
